description: This file defines culture-specific information for the Xhosa language as used in South Africa (xh-ZA). It sets day names, month names, date formats, regex patterns for parsing dates, and extends the Date object with culture-aware methods. The file appears to be a culture info configuration module for date handling libraries.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components of a Date object to midnight.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the Date object to the current date and time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this Date object to another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two Date objects are equal.
